title: Legalize runtime pi at the dispatch door with herding-only enforcement and ship the belt
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check
action: (1) DISPATCH_RUNTIMES (prepare.rs:29) and the hand-maintained generated/registry_payload.json enums on dispatch.prepare AND dispatch.wave gain pi; RUNTIMES (models.rs:34) widens to 4. (2) One refusal helper for runtime pi: every slot resolution that is not Resolved::Herding — Model (plain string), Native, Cli, Budget, and Inherit (escalation / --role ceiling) — refuses naming the slot, the herding requirement, and for escalation the remedy: Pi has no subagent surface, run the escalated cell inline in the session. Wire it in prepare AND wave. (3) devtools/mod.rs render_projection_text_for gains the pi => None label arm; hook_manifests.rs named-exclusion comment (lines ~44-52) extends to Pi — NO Runtime::Pi, NO fourth projection. (4) onboard copy_pi_extension across apply.rs/plan.rs/source.rs/tests.rs mirroring copy_opencode_plugin five-site shape, shipping .pi/extensions/bee-guard.ts from the checkout tree. (5) release_manifest.rs INVENTORY_ROOTS gains .pi/extensions + regenerate docs/history/codex-harness-hardening/release-manifest.json via bee dev release-manifest --write. Unit tests per the plan Config/Registry matrix rows (plain-string, cli, native, ceiling, wave, herding-payload, unconfigured-role, D6 table values).

truths: dispatch prepare --runtime pi --kind cell on a herding slot returns the herding-exec payload
a plain-string models.pi slot refuses (never an Agent payload)
an escalated cell on pi refuses with the inline-session remedy
dispatch wave --runtime pi takes the same refusals

artifacts.substantive: non-herding refusal helper wired in prepare and wave

key_links: registry_payload.json and DISPATCH_RUNTIMES agree on the runtime set

trace.outcome: runtime pi is legal at the dispatch door, herding-only with typed refusals on every other resolution, and the belt ships through onboard plus the release inventory
deviations: Reserved and edited two files the cell did not name — verbs/drivers/tests.rs and verbs/models_group.rs — because widening DISPATCH_RUNTIMES and RUNTIMES turned 12 existing tests red (walks over both constants); the driver walks now configure a herding models.pi table instead of skipping pi, so pi stays inside the derived matrix — something else had to be fixed first

Ran the release-manifest proof with the binary built from this cell (/home/thanhsmind/.cache/cargo-target/release/bee) instead of the cell verify line's .bee/bin/bee, which is a symlink to the main checkout's binary built before this change and cannot know the new .pi/extensions root — the plan was wrong about a fact
Wired the wave door to unwind its own claim on a pi refusal rather than pushing an ok:false payload carrying claimed:true, so a refused pi wave leaks no claims — found a better route
